metadata.description: See where your Claude Code money goes, and what would have kept it.

plugins.name: claude-usage
plugins.description: Analyze your Claude Code usage from local transcripts: an HTML report on cost, caching, context, sessions, tools, subagents and hooks with an efficiency score and a grade per area, Claude-written insights with what each change would have saved, optimizations you can apply one by one, a short video of your highlights, the whole report as one file to send, and a company report combining many people's files.
